summary: A model server is a web server with a common API. You write a client for any OpenAI-compatible server (the address, the model name and the key are the only things that change), call a local model with curl and with your own client, stream the answer, see the slow first call, and see a small model invent a meaning for E104 when it has no sources. Run with mlx_lm.server; Ollama and vLLM were not run.
goal: M14: call a local model with the same client code.

items.text: Start a model server and call it with curl
Add local_llm.py and ask_local.py and set the four variables for your server
Ask the same question twice and predict which call is slower, then ask about E104 without sources
Point the address at a port with nothing, then ask for a missing model name, and read both errors
Make the streaming script print the time of the first piece and the pieces per second
Commit the client, the script, pyproject.toml and uv.lock
Play the Server Check game to the end and see your score
